gen-dafont-junegull-gf-noto-sans-tagalog: Junegull stamps every curve with the same ink weight and a pinched mouth, like cast iron capitals turned lowercase. And Noto Sans Tagalog keeps a plain sans middle zone dominant, so body text could sit comfortably a few points smaller.
gen-dafont-junegull-gf-noto-sans-tagbanw: Junegull brings retro, friendly lettering with pinched curve mouths and a towering lowercase, while Noto Sans Tagbanwa below it stays open and modern. Tight up top, loose below.
gen-dafont-junegull-gf-noto-sans-tai-le: Not a hint of thick and thin anywhere in Junegull's retro, friendly letters. Noto Sans Tai Le follows with tapered strokes and barely any step from capital to lowercase, so the page moves from stamped to soft.
gen-dafont-junegull-gf-noto-sans-tai-tha: Junegull draws its letters as if traced with one marker. Noto Sans Tai Tham then reads like chalk-board lowercase pushed up toward the capital line, with the inside of each c easy to spot, so a long passage feels contemporary and unhurried.
gen-dafont-junegull-gf-noto-sans-tai-vie: Junegull is retro and friendly, with curves pinched nearly shut. Noto Sans Tai Viet answers with short ascenders, a tall x-height and terminals pulled back from each curve, so the closed heading sits above a body that breathes.
gen-dafont-junegull-gf-noto-sans-takri: Junegull makes every curve as thick as a straight stem, giving its retro, friendly lowercase real weight on the page. Noto Sans Takri reads smoothly beneath it, high-waisted and generously unclosed.
gen-dafont-junegull-gf-noto-sans-tamil-s: Round forms that look like open parentheses give this body a contemporary, stocky feel from its tall middle band. Noto Sans Tamil Supplement meets Junegull's closed, outline-like letters in a single width, and that open-versus-closed tension is the pair's real hook.
gen-dafont-junegull-gf-noto-sans-tangsa: Round letters open wide and ascender stems stay short, which makes this body feel inviting and easy to settle into. Junegull's closed, retro shapes sit above it, so Noto Sans Tangsa feels all the more open.
gen-dafont-junegull-gf-noto-sans-tc: Large open counters in the tall a, e and s let this body read with outward-turning, approachable curves. Junegull's stems and crossbars share one thickness, so it closes up where Noto Sans TC opens out.
gen-dafont-junegull-gf-noto-sans-telugu: Stamped, retro and friendly, Junegull holds a high-set midline against counters that stay connected to the outside in Noto Sans Telugu. Shrink the heading and its pinched, closed curves would fade.
